claims: The 2026 FIFA World Cup final tournament is set for June 11 to July 19, 2026.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup final tournament is in Canada, Mexico, and the USA.
The FIFA Play-Off Tournament for the 2026 World Cup qualifiers is in March 2026.
The FIFA Play-Off Tournament will decide the last slots for the 2026 World Cup.
The finals of the FIFA Play-Off Tournament are scheduled in Monterrey and Guadalajara.
UEFA 2026 World Cup qualifier group stages run from March 2025 through late 2025.
UEFA 2026 World Cup qualifier results from early 2025 include wins for Italy, Norway, and Croatia.
Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Paraguay, and Uruguay have secured qualification for the 2026 World Cup through CONMEBOL.
